svg.title: Read the identity checks on an incoming email
svg.desc: The receiving mail service records checks on the sender. Use the results for the same message before drawing a conclusion. Sending server. SPF checks whether the sending server is listed for the sending domain. Signature. DKIM checks a signature on the message using a published key. Visible sender. DMARC checks whether a passing SPF or DKIM result lines up with the domain in the From address.
